### Job's First Lament
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jobs-first-lament
Passage: Job 3:1-26
Points:
- Deep suffering and grief can lead even faithful believers into dark despair.
- While Job stopped short of cursing God directly, wishing he was never born implicitly questioned God's wisdom.
- Scripture permits honest lament and questions, but drawing the line before arrogantly doubting God's goodness is essential.
- Job 3:25–26 refutes modern claims that fear inevitably manifests disaster; Scripture guarantees no such principle.
- In seasons of hardship, believers are called to seek the grace to endure faithfully rather than demand explanations.
